newsitem.title: UK: NWE oil products weaker, gas oil sharply sold.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products weaker, gas oil sharply sold.

text.p: NWE oil products were weaker on Monday, traders said.
Gasoline was weaker although European markets failed to catch up with the falls in NYMEX futures. Eurograde barges traded between $188 and $192 a tonne fob ARA.
Gas oil eased as benchmark IPE futures nosedived with the front-month June contract closing $4.25 lower at $161.00 a tonne. Heating oil barges traded at June IPE +$1.0-$1.25 fob Rott during the day.
High sulphur barges eased, catching up with crude's recent fall and suffering from lower demand.
They traded late at $85.50 and $85 a tonne fob ARA after an early deal at $86, some $1.50 lower that Friday's highest price
A high sulphur cargo was reported trading at a strong $81.75 fob Coryton but several traders said the price was too high and did not reflect the market. --London newsroom, +44 171 542 8145
